scope: Task006 report, anonymized inputs, measured results, validation code, public evidence derivatives and attribution. Excludes private originals, local profiles, raw host conversations, model weights and runtime environments.
integrity: SHA-256 values below cover exact published bytes, excluding this manifest itself. Image and trace manifests separately label private original hashes and published derivative hashes. This verifies package integrity, not independent image quality or scientific generalizability.
privacy_review: Each publication file reviewed in scope; images decoded and visually reviewed, metadata removed; text/structured records reviewed and scanned for credentials, account data, local paths, private addresses and unrelated machine fingerprints. Review mapping and untouched originals remain private.
